title: Make voxel games on ThreeJS, it's worth it!
author: ResenhaDoBar
selftext: For those who are still not aware: AI is very good at making voxel assets, use this to your advantage. These days for game jams and similar projects voxel style tends to be my go-to.

comments.author: Revelation12Studios
comments.body: Now that's neat. How long have you been working on it for?

replies.body: Took about a week to get to this point!
